analysis: The code is a constructor for the class ParameterNotInstantiableException. It takes a Parameter object and calls parameter.toString() (implicitly via string concatenation) and parameter.getDeclaringInvokable(). These methods may throw NullPointerException if the parameter is null. Since this is a constructor for an exception class, it is typically invoked when the parameter is expected to be non-null. The NullPointerException is a runtime exception, but catching it here would obscure programming errors. Therefore, no runtime exception handling is required within this snippet.
